notes: Posted 8 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting 5': Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers, Rendezvous Point, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Strike Planning, Insurrection; these count toward the 60. Two Effects start and neither is named as the starting Effect, so none is set.
The section header 'Admiral s Orders 1' was mis-parsed as a card and is removed; total is 60 as published.
Generic systems dested the Light pages: Endor (Light), Hoth (Light), Kessel (Premiere), Kiffex (Jabba's Palace).
Posted 'Collision' dested Collision!. 'Houjix & Out Of Nowhere' and 'Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated' are the combo interrupts.
The strategy says the deck 'will be premiering at a tourney on June 8th in Oxford, NC'; no result is given, so it stays a general deck.
